Amount: dues_base 50,000円 + dues_step_amount 5,000円 for every full dues_party_support_step 15 Party support above dues_party_support_start 40 + dues_reward_percent 15% of the Funds earned Monday to Friday, never more than dues_max_per_week; the awareness relief (AE01) comes off after the limit
Caps and limits: dues_max_per_week 90,000円; dues_holiday_weeks 3 free weeks at the start

Amount: the 15% share of Funds earned that week: more earned, more owed
Caps and limits: included in FL501; counted before the Funds cap clamps a win (P17)

Amount: At Party support party_support_funding_freeze 0 every room and level pays no Funds until Party support is above 0 again (funding_frozen_active)
Caps and limits: events, visitors and laws still pay Funds

Amount: A week's dues the Funds cannot cover roll over: dues_overdue_party_support 30 Party support once; dues_overdue_party_hq 20 standing with Party Headquarters and dues_overdue_selection_committee 5 with the Selection Committee, each x dues_overdue_scale_factor 1.5 for every dues_overdue_scale_per 100,000円 owed; the party's backings are withdrawn (dues_debt_locks_backings)
Caps and limits: penalties grow with the debt

Amount: each other party's favorability toward the player rises dues_overdue_other_parties 5 (x the debt factor) when dues go unpaid
At Party support party_support_steering_committee 25 or below the Steering Committee check-in is forced in: a room whose win lifts Party support
Caps and limits: a short week or an unwon check-in costs Party support

Amount: staff_wage_percent 10% of everything invested in each hired person (hire plus upgrades) every week; staff_raise_pay_multiple_percent 150% if their pay was raised
Caps and limits: paid primary staff first when Funds run short

Amount: A paid week adds staff_loyalty_paid_bonus to Loyalty, a missed wage costs staff_loyalty_missed_penalty; below staff_loyalty_leaving_below a person quits; tenure, taste, task fit and gifts move it
Caps and limits: Loyalty 0-100; staff_loyalty_start

Amount: decay_percent 10 of the distance back to the starting value each week, x week_decay_multiplier 2.5, at least 1 point
decay_percent 6 of the distance back to the starting value each week, x week_decay_multiplier
each organization settles back toward its starting standing by decay_percent 5 of the distance each week, x week_decay_multiplier
an organization whose standing did not move in the period drifts neglect_decay 1 point (x the week multiplier) toward its start
Caps and limits: only organizations left untouched

Amount: gains are x1 below 40 standing, x0.6 below 60, x0.4 above; losses x1 below 60, x1.5 above (gain_bands, loss_bands); per_please 5, per_displease 3
Caps and limits: standing 0-100

Amount: pleasing one organization moves its allies up and its rivals down (standing_links_yen_per_point); the sign of the effect depends on the pair
Caps and limits: triggers no further links when decaying

Amount: National awareness at 80 or more takes 50,000円 off the weekly dues
District awareness at 80 or more gives one free Rhetoric Training coupon each week end
National awareness at 65 or more: +5 starting support in press, TV and ambush rooms (42 stages)
District awareness at 65 or more: +5 starting support in district rooms (18 stages)
District awareness at 25 or below: -10 standing with the Selection Committee (BO32) each week end
District awareness at 13 or below: -50 XP each week end
National awareness at 20 or below: -5 standing with every National organization each week end, growing by 5 for each week in a row
Caps and limits: grows each week in a row

Amount: leftover gaffes add to one run total; each time it passes another awareness_gaffes_per_roll 30 a roll (awareness_gaffe_roll_chance 0.2) may cost 1 District and National awareness, and each blunder_gaffes_per_roll 25 a Blunder! roll (blunder_chance 1/3); a stage lost to gaffes rolls for a Blunder! too
Caps and limits: the rolls are seeded by the run; a Blunder! never takes a meter below blunder_floor 21

Amount: passing your own bill: awareness_passed_own_bill_national and awareness_passed_own_bill_district; flipping a bill by influence: awareness_flipped_bill_national

moves toward its potential by election_gain_per_week 2.5 up (election_gain_per_week_mustering 6 during mustering) or election_fall_per_week 1.5 down each week; the potential is built from awareness, Constituency, organizations, the campaign fund (election_war_chest_target, election_war_chest_limit), campaign capital (election_capital_target; fades election_capital_fade_percent a week), record (election_record_target) and party backing. Since P20 it feeds the Candidate Selection Committee's score (selection_weight_*) once phase D is built; until then it still fires nothing
Inputs: awareness_district[+]; awareness_national[+]; constituency[+]; org_standing[+]; xp[+]; party_support[+]
Caps and limits: election_max_* weights; no effect on play

Amount: moved by SGxx reward targets (shop items, staff rewards) and kept in the run; no mechanic reads it. Re-checked 2026-11-25: still read by nothing
Caps and limits: clamped 0-100

Amount: Funds above the cap are lost: funds_starting_cap 100,000円 to start; the petition (SH13) raises it by 100,000円 a purchase up to the sanban ceiling 1,000,000円
Caps and limits: a stage win clamps at the cap; dues are counted before the clamp

Amount: each suit is worth 0.5-1.5x in each room (affinity.json); a card played in the room's favored suit is worth most
an answer graded S x question_strong_multiplier 1.3, W x question_weak_multiplier 0.7; knowing a room's favored style (tips, reference desk) lets the player pick the strong answer
Reputation at special_effects_reputation_threshold 80 or more: press-style rooms start press_start_reputation_bonus +5
Reputation at 20 or below: press-style rooms start 5 down
Party support above party_support_allied_buff 75: the free backing M09 applies in every room
Constituency support at jiban_town_hall_trigger 15 or below: a Town Hall room is forced in, a recovery chance
a backing needs its trigger organizations at required_standing 60 or more (a few override it)
Caps and limits: timed backings lapse

Amount: after gaffes_lifetime_penalty_threshold 50 gaffes over the run: gaffes_lifetime_penalty_jiban_delta -15 Constituency, once
Caps and limits: once per run

Amount: Funds buy items, staff and backings, which raise the room win rate
Source: derived: the Marketplace, Hire staff and Backing purchase rows

Amount: XP buys cards (Rhetoric Training) and level unlocks, which raise the win rate and the pay
Source: derived: Rhetoric Training and level unlock rows

Amount: more deck slots let the player carry more of the cards they own
Caps and limits: starter deck size fixed; deck_expansion_maximum_purchases 5

Amount: a donation traded for in a lobbyist meeting: trade_donation_funds 10,000円 and trade_donation_xp 20 XP, at a cost in standing or favor (trade_cost_*)
Caps and limits: trade_rounds per meeting

Amount: SPENDS whip_base_cost 10 Party support a seat (x whip_against_party_multiplier 3 against your party), at most whip_max_per_vote 3 seats a vote, never below whip_party_support_floor 30
Caps and limits: floor 30

Amount: GAINS seats on a vote, which decide whether a bill becomes a law
your lean on a bill gains lean_party_support_delta 2 with one side and loses 2 with the other; voting with or against your party moves Party support against organizations (stance_vote_delta)
party positions and organization standing shape how members vote
SPENDS draft_bill_xp_cost 350 XP and draft_bill_funds_cost 300,000円 (draft_bill_cooldown_units apart)
GAINS a custom bill that can be carried to a vote and become a law

SPENDS the card's tier price in XP (a tier-1 to tier-3 card; the whole collection is about 28,000 XP), or a Training Session Coupon; one draw shows card_training_looks 3 cards, the last must be learned
Caps and limits: a card is learned once; deck size fixed

Amount: GAINS a card for the deck
a locked level costs XP to unlock (unlock_cost_vacant, unlock_cost_tier_0..2) when level_gating_enabled
GAINS a level the player may now play, with its room pay and end-of-level bonus
SPENDS staff_slots_reputation_cost 15 Reputation a purchase, up to staff_slots_maximum_purchases
GAINS a place for one more hired person
GAINS a certain stage tip for 2 hours (VA18); at most tips_max_held 10 held, each lasting tips_days 14 days; Cafeteria, Gardens and Speech Coach lines also give tips (venue_hint_share)
Caps and limits: tips_max_held 10

Amount: GAINS documents to read; found by venue lines, laws and the start of a run
codex_first_read_xp 5 XP the first time each document is read, never again
Caps and limits: once per document

Amount: room and level Funds and XP are paid at difficulty_relaxed_reward_percent 115 / 100 / difficulty_harder_reward_percent 85 percent
item prices are difficulty_harder_item_price_percent 115% at Harder (difficulty_relaxed_item_price_percent at Relaxed)
promise deadlines (difficulty_*_promise_deadline_percent) and the standing a broken promise costs (difficulty_*_promise_broken_standing)
a kept promise pays promise_kept_standing 2 standing; a broken one costs promise_broken_standing -5 standing and promise_broken_reputation -2 Reputation

Fundraising calls cost campaign_fundraise_xp 100 XP, Outreach letters campaign_letters_xp 60 XP and Mailings campaign_mailings_xp 200 XP; the XP becomes campaign capital (the campaign's own stock), which fades election_capital_fade_percent a week
Caps and limits: campaign_actions_per_week 2 before the campaign opens; none after

Amount: Each campaign action takes campaign_action_hours 4 hours (campaign_action_hours_with_organizer 2 for letters and mailings with an Organizer)
Caps and limits: the week's work hours

Amount: Funds moved one way into the campaign fund in the Rules steps (campaign_donate_steps 10,000 to 500,000円) at the District office
Caps and limits: the campaign fund ceiling election_war_chest_limit; the overflow is lost

Amount: Letters give campaign_letters_standing 3 standing with one organization, Mailings campaign_mailings_standing 1 with every local organization (x campaign_sprint_multiplier 1.5 during mustering); the van's speech costs campaign_van_speech_penalty 2 with BO18 and BO25

Mailings give campaign_mailings_district 1 and the van's speech campaign_van_speech_district 2 District awareness (x1.5 during mustering); the van needs the campaign fund (campaign_van_speech_cost 20,000円 a speech)
Caps and limits: awareness is 0 to 100

Amount: Campaign staff (hire 150 capital and 300,000円, upgrades double) and the van (500,000円, 1,500,000円, 3,000,000円) are paid from the campaign fund; wages are a share of what was invested each week; they work only for the campaign and go home after Election Day
Caps and limits: one primary per role

Amount: Campaign Moment! scenes (DS12 to DS24, drawn at most once a day while the campaign_moments_per_week_building 1 or _late 2 budget lasts) ask for the campaign fund: toasts and dinners 10,000 to 50,000円, a colleague's 100,000 or 300,000円; DS11's choice B puts 50,000円 of the player's Funds into it
Caps and limits: budget per week; a cost greys the choice when the fund cannot cover it

Amount: Helping a colleague pays Party support (+2 to +5), organization standing (BO17, BO31, BO32 +1 to +3) and National awareness (+1, +2); declining costs 1 Party support. Each helped colleague is owed a favor (nothing spends favors yet)
Caps and limits: cooldowns 3 to 4 weeks per scene

Amount: At each week's end xp_decay_percent 15% of the Political Capital above xp_decay_floor 300 fades (1,000 loses 105); lifetime Political Capital is not touched. With 620 earned a week and nothing spent it settles near 3,813
Caps and limits: a hold does not stop it; the Office shows the fade from Wednesday
Difficulty: xp_price_relaxed_percent and xp_price_harder_percent scale the prices of the things that stop it

Amount: party_support_decay_at_50 5 a week while 50 to 74, party_support_decay_at_75 8 from 75, never below 50 from this rule
Caps and limits: stopped for a week by Shore up support (decay_hold_xp 200, +decay_hold_step_xp 50 each week in a row)

Amount: District and National awareness lose awareness_decay_percent 2% of the distance above their start (awareness_start_district 20, awareness_start_national 10), at least 1 while above it
Caps and limits: stopped for a week by Shore up support

Mechanic: Shore up support and Keep in touch
Amount: decay_hold_xp 200 (+50 each week in a row on the same meter) stops one meter's decay for the week; keep_in_touch_xp 60 (+20) stops one organization's
Caps and limits: once per meter or organization a week; a hold never raises anything

Amount: dues_bailout_xp 100 Political Capital writes off dues_bailout_yen 10,000円 of the dues owed
Caps and limits: only while dues are owed

Mechanic: Funds limit: petition steps and calls
Amount: The petition (SH13) costs 100 Political Capital, +50 each purchase, up to funds_petition_ceiling 1,000,000; the call on the party (200 PC and 50 Party support, Party support over 70) and on the financial industry (150 PC and 40 standing, standing over 70) each add 500,000円 once per run, up to 2,000,000
Caps and limits: once each per run; the dues limit follows the cap (dues_limit_cap_percent 90%)

Amount: A Blunder! takes blunder_awareness_delta -10 District and National awareness, never below blunder_floor 21 (a meter at or under 21 loses nothing)
Caps and limits: a Media Spokesperson (not busy with delegated work) cancels it for blunder_cancel_xp_tier_0/1/2 200/150/100 PC

Amount: Cancelling a Blunder! costs blunder_cancel_xp_tier_0 200, _1 150 or _2 100 Political Capital by the highest Media Spokesperson tier
Caps and limits: only with a Media Spokesperson hired and free

Amount: After a Blunder! card, a Scandal! (blunder_scandal_chance 1/8, checked first) or a Rumor! (blunder_rumor_chance 1/3) is recorded as a pending accusation (halved when cancelled); phase D turns it into a card with penalties
Caps and limits: recorded only until the accusation card is built

Amount: trim_deck_xp 75 Political Capital (+trim_deck_step_xp 25 each card already trimmed) removes one card from the deck and the cards owned for the run; the deck loses a slot too
Caps and limits: the deck never goes below trim_deck_min_size 12

Amount: mentoring_xp 100 Political Capital cancels the Loyalty loss from this week's unpaid or late wage for one person
Caps and limits: once per staff member a week

Amount: pep_talk_xp 60 Political Capital gives one person pep_talk_loyalty 5 Loyalty
Caps and limits: once per staff member a week

Amount: rush_request_xp 60 Political Capital buys a Library reading without its 2 hours
Caps and limits: once a day
